_about.what: Test consultations. Each is a scripted sequence of user messages.
_about.why: Written before the outputs were inspected, and chosen to include the cases most likely to embarrass the system rather than the ones most likely to flatter it: an expired deadline, a wage above the ceiling that closes the cheap route, a safety disclosure that must outrank the money question, a problem outside scope, and two deliberate attempts to make the model invent law.
_about.frozen_today: Every case fixes `today`, so deadline arithmetic is reproducible and the committed outputs do not rot.
_about.expectations: `expect` is checked automatically by run.py. It asserts on the computed layer (forum, deadline, escalation), never on the model's wording.
